name: Jordan Pike
want: keep this group alive long enough to find somewhere safer
voice: Few words, dry humor, calm under pressure.
description: Drove the same county routes for ten years and knows every back road. Ended up at Harmon's by chance and stayed because someone had to keep things steady.
appearance: Medium build in a faded courier jacket, with short dark hair, a road-map tattoo on one forearm and a crowbar never far from reach.
